definitions.explanation: a sale that is only available for a limited period, often a few hours

examples.japanese: タイムセール⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧タイムセール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Bento boxes are half price during the evening time sale.

examples.japanese: Amazon ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧タイムセール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しかった→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}えた→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I was able to buy what I wanted cheaply during Amazon's flash sale.

notes:
タイムセール is a wasei-eigo (Japanese-coined English) term for limited-time sales promotions.

USAGE:
- Supermarkets: Evening タイムセール on ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧, ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧, and ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ before closing
- Online shopping: Amazon, {楽天|らくてん} flash sales lasting a few hours
- Department stores: Seasonal clearance events

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- タイムセール⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: the flash sale starts
- タイムセール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy during a flash sale
- タイムセール⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: during the sale period

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{特売|とくばい}→特売：04277_tokubai⟧: special sale (general)
- ⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: half-price sale
- ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: closing sale
- ゲリラ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: unannounced flash sale
